content.text:
Aspect ratio: 3:1 (the image will be 1536x512).
Time of day: day
Place: auto (decide from the sketch)
Perspective chosen by the artist: flat front view. Camera sentence, copy it verbatim as item 4: "Camera: eye level and straight on, a flat frontal view with almost no perspective: the back wall is parallel to the picture, horizontal lines stay horizontal and vertical lines stay vertical."
Image 1: rough sketch by our artist (layout source).
Style examples: auto mode. Choose up to two from this style library (their small thumbnails follow the input images):
  L1: 학교 앞 횡단보도 (exterior, day)
  L2: 아파트 집 안 (현관에서 본 거실) (interior, day)
  L3: 공원 벤치 (exterior, day)
  L4: 작은 집 방 (소파, 에어컨) (interior, day)
  L5: 아파트 공동현관 (낮) (exterior, day)
  L6: 아파트 공동현관 (밤) (exterior, night)
  L7: 아파트 단지와 거리 (exterior, day)
  L8: 초등학교 교실 (interior, day)
  L9: 나무 아지트 안 (interior, any)
  L10: 공중화장실 (interior, any)
  L11: 공원 정자 (exterior, day)
  L12: 놀이터 (exterior, day)
Base style strip: always sent as the last image. In the prompt write {BASE} for its number and {S1}, {S2} for the style examples.
Artist's request (Korean): 아주 긴 팬.
Write the order sheet now. Follow the manual exactly: its markers or verbatim sentences, the numbers of Image 1 and the references, and the placeholders.

order.raw: Generate an image of a long school hallway. 1. Layout: image 1. Camera: as chosen. [STYLE] [TIME interior] [AVOID] Aspect ratio 16:9.
order.prompt: Generate an image of a long school hallway. 1. Layout: image 1. Camera: as chosen. Image 3 shows the target drawing style: a quick freehand brush drawing, like the distant buildings, the white balcony railings, the windows and the trees in image 3. Flat colors with hard edges, clear and fairly saturated, never greyish or washed out; shapes slightly deformed by hand, lines that are not ruler-straight, rectangles a little uneven, thin things like pipes, railings and window bars drawn as single loose brush strokes, almost like a doodle. It must not look wavy or warped. Flat cel shading, no gradients, no glow, no texture, no black outlines. Time: daytime. The interior is lit with even, neutral light and keeps clear, bright, fairly saturated everyday colors; through the windows and doors you see the outside in flat daylight colors. Avoid: sketch lines, labels or handwriting from image 1, ruler-straight vector lines, perfect geometry, wavy distortion, fisheye distortion, black outlines, photorealism, glossy highlights, gradients, soft airbrush, glow, light falloff, light rays, painterly texture, dull greyish or washed-out colors, the playground objects of image 3, the objects, layout or text of the style examples, people. Aspect ratio 3:1.
